notes: The ASV's *when* subordinates a temporal clause the Hebrew writes asyndetically (תָּקְעוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת), and no preposition or conjunction morpheme stands in that clause for it. The verse pass folded it into the הָיָה frame; but the frame's complementizer is the word written at the head of the apodosis (rule 45), and here the ASV opens the apodosis bare and leaves its waw unrendered. JOS.6.20 writes the same *when* for a present כְּ and gives its *that* to the apodosis waw, and JOS.6.18 marks a supplied *when* `added`, so the word is `added` under rule 55 and the frame keeps only *it came to pass*.
